metachart.interface.boolean.description: Boolean flag. A string is rendered as a Go template with the chart context and must produce `true` or `false`

metachart.interface.context.description: Facts about the resource, free form. The resource context is the release `context` merged with `settings.<kind>.defaults.context` and with this key (the resource wins), exposed to the preprocessors and to every template of the resource as `$.Metachart.Resource.context`; never rendered into the object

context.description: Release context: free form facts used by templates. Merged with `global.context` before rendering and inherited by every resource as the bottom layer of its own `context` ($.Metachart.Resource.context)

global.description: Values shared with sub-charts. `settings`, `context` and every root key marked `global: true` in the chart config are merged into the top-level keys of the same name before rendering: local keys win, dictionaries merge recursively, lists are concatenated
